modId.description: Must match both the corresponding mods/<id>.json id AND the id encoded in this file's own filename. A loader MUST cross-check filename vs this field and reject the archive on mismatch -- cheap insurance against a mis-extracted or hand-edited archive applying the wrong patch to the wrong mod.

sequence.description: Absent/null for a single non-chained patch. Present for a chain (filename suffix -1, -2, -3...), applied in ascending numeric order.

targetPath.description: Path within the installed mod this patch applies to. Matched via NFC-normalized, case-folded comparison -- same normalization GMM's OverlayFS case-insensitivity layer already uses, reused here rather than reimplemented.

baseFileSha256.description: Hash of the file this patch expects to apply to. A mismatch at apply time means the upstream mod file changed since the pack was authored -- surface as a diagnostic, do not apply blindly.

payloadBase64.description: The diff itself. Patches are embedded by default and gated behind a single runtime Allow/Do Not Allow consent dialog listing every patched mod -- this is a deliberate product decision, not a technical constraint, see the accompanying spec doc.
